title: Little Nachman Part 14
body:
Translation by Rabbi Lazer Brody
and illustrations by Rebecca Shapiro
 
 
Little Nachman – Part 14
 
"How are you, Shimon?" asked Nachman.
 
"Baruch Hashem, thanks to Hashem I feel fine. But, my mother doesn’t feel so good so I decided to stay home and help her with the household chores. I also prepared hot tea for her."
 
"Maybe I can help you," said Nachman. “We’ll straighten out the house, do the dishes, and take out the trash."
 
"Thanks so much," smiled Shimon. "Come inside – you’re most welcome, Nachman. Thank you for your helping hand."

 
To be continued, G-d willing.
